mapper.select:
select id, name, threshold_amount, discount_amount, total_stock, stock, receive_start_time, receive_end_time, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, status, create_time, update_time from coupon
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.update: update coupon set name = #{coupon.name}, threshold_amount = #{coupon.thresholdAmount}, discount_amount = #{coupon.discountAmount}, total_stock = #{coupon.totalStock}, stock = #{coupon.stock}, receive_start_time = #{coupon.receiveStartTime}, receive_end_time = #{coupon.receiveEndTime}, valid_start_time = #{coupon.validStartTime}, valid_end_time = #{coupon.validEndTime}, update_time = #{coupon.updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0
